description: This file contains utility functions for header analysis, including string replacement, element comparison, and collection manipulation, used within the header checker tool.

methods.name: FindAndReplace
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring in a string with another string using regex.

methods.name: FindRemovedElements
methods.description: Returns a vector of elements present in the old map but removed in the new map.

methods.name: AddToMap
methods.description: Adds elements from a collection to a map, using provided key and value getter functions.

methods.name: AddToSet
methods.description: Adds elements from a collection to a set, using a provided key getter function.

methods.name: FindCommonElements
methods.description: Finds common elements between two maps and returns pairs of corresponding values.
